Jessi is the oldest member of MomTok at 33, the owner of JZ Styles, and an accomplished hair dresser. She doesn't hold anything back as she navigates the complicated dynamics of her friend group. She is the mother of three children and is married to Jordan Ngatikaura. Jessi was placed in The Sinners subgroup of MomTok for being divorced and following less of the Mormon churches guidelines since leaving the organization. Any inaccuracies or updates since their release should not be altered. Season 2 Jessi Ngatikaura, 32 Relationship Status: Married to Jordan Ngatikaura Kids: 3 TikTok Followers: 821.5K Known for: Owning a hair salon (JZ Styles), being a part of the “sinners” MomTok subgroup, and leaving the Mormon church. Season 1 TikTok: 123.6k[2] Instagram: 139k[2] Fun fact: Calls herself "the grandma of the group."[2] Why she's excited about the show: I feel the show fits into my life naturally, and there's no need to change. I can be authentically myself. I also enjoy making content and sharing it online with my audience.[2] Relationship Status: Divorced and re-married, Jessi has a blended family with three kids.[2] Secret Lives of Mormon Wives[] Season 1[] In The First Book of Taylor, 30-year-old Jessi is a newer member of MomTok who got her start building a hair empire, JZ Styles. She joins the rest of MomTok in discussing Taylor, the scandal, and Whitney's impending return. She is the bluntest of the moms and claims was at some of the parties, but never picked up a vibe. Her husband Jordan picked up a vibe from the husbands because they were asking him if he was the jealous type. She denies that either of them were involved in the scandal. Jessi later styles Mikayla's hair and dyes Whitney's red at JZ Styles. In The Book of Belonging, In The Book of Saints & Sinners, In The Book of Truth, In The Book of Broken Vows, In The First Book of Sin, In The Book of Trust, In The Book of Rumors, Season 2[] In The Book of Revelations, Jessi attends an influencer event with the rest of MomTok. They're surprised when Whitney arrives, though the girls all give her the cold shoulder. Jessi is shocked when Miranda McWhorter shows up at the event wanting to rejoin the group. Jessi is eager to hear Miranda's side of things because she didn't really know the girl beforehand. Miranda claims she was never a swinger like Taylor claims, leaving Jessi confused on who to believe. Mikayla, Demi, Jessi, and Mayci go to a haunted house together. They wonder if they should go to Miranda's ice breaker party. Mayci accuses Jessi and Demi of kissing Miranda's ass at the party, which Demi instantly denies. Jessi doesn't know Miranda and doesn't know how to act around her. Demi defends herself as she's not kissing ass, she's just only interested in hearing the truth. Jessi wants to hear both sides. In The Book of Accountability, In The Book of Retribution, In The Book of Taboos, In The Book of Divisions, In The Book of Redemption, In The Book of Gratitude, In The Book of Betrayal, In The Book of Reckoning, In The Book of Salvation, In Reunion Special, Season 3[] Season 4[] In The Book of Taking Flight, In The Book of Secrets, In The Book of True Colors, In The Book of Exodus, In The Book of Power and Pain, In The Book of Conceit, In The Book of Fragile Egos, In The Book of Unearthing, In The Book of Coveting, In The Book of Thorns and Roses, Relationships[] MomTok[] Taylor Frankie Paul: Demi Engemann: Demi and Jessi were the most popular friendship to come from Secret Lives of Mormon Wives Season 1, and were seen doing several activities together off-screen. They were part of a running joke on social media where viewers couldn't tell them apart. They considered each other best friends and stuck for each other on-screen. Their friendship drove a lot of interviews and they were supportive of each others endeavors. This changed between seasons one and two during a pay discrepancy for the series, in which Demi wanted more money for the second season, and was willing to lose Jessi as a cast member to get it. The girls did make up after the ordeal off-screen, but the drama was brought up again during a round of Truth Box. Things soured when Taylor decided to tell all the girls that Demi was telling people not to go to JZ Styles for hair. Their friendship completely fell apart and Jessi didn't support Demi in her conflict against Taylor, refusing to speak up as she had in private. After her fallout with Jessi and being unsupported against Taylor, Demi quit MomTok. The two stopped being friends and unfollowed each other on social media, with Jessi blocking Demi. I just don't know if I could handle, like, four other guys." —Jessi when asked if she was involved in the Swinging Scandal in The First Book of Taylor Appearances[] For non-television based appearances, please see Jessi Draper/Appearances. She was recommended for the series by Mayci,[4] who messaged Jessi on social media to ask if she was interested in filming for the new Pilot. She agreed and attended the last-minute audition with half her hair done.[5] Jessi is not a practicing Mormon. She grew up in the religion, but doesn't identify as one anymore.[6] She was asked to submit an interview for The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City and went through the process. A year later, she found an email in her spam folder from them asking her to come back in that she never saw.[4] Jessi claimed in September of 2024 that she never had plastic surgery on her face, only botox and lip filler. She explained that her husband didn't want her to touch her face or go extreme. She did have a breast reduction for smaller implants after giving birth.[4] Following the success of Season 1 and Season 2, Jessi's house became a target for fans. They frequently drove by to take photos. She and Jordan decided to move as a result.[5] Between seasons three and four, Jessi changed her professional name from "Jessi Ngatikaura" to "Jessi Draper". She explained it was partly because of peoples inability to correctly pronounce it. She wanted to succeed in the limelight and knew she should have a name that people could easily pronounce and remember. She reverted to her maiden name, which is also the name of her family that she employs as part of her family business.[1] She had been thinking about going by "Draper" since before the first season premiered, but didn't go through with it. Her decision to use her maiden name played out onscreen during the fourth season. Jessi won Page Six's 2025 Boss Babe Award for her work with JZ Styles. She beat out Guerdy Abraira (Real Housewives of Miami), Bozoma Saint John (Real Housewives of Beverly Hills), Melissa Gorga (Real Housewives of New Jersey), and Kim Kardashian (The Kardashians). On March 19, 2026, it was revealed that Jordan filed for divorce from Jessi. He released a statement asking for privacy, that he would be prioritizing his children, and handling the next chapter with "kindness and respect."[7] The filing came days after Jessi's interview with People magazine where she shared the couple were going through therapy and working on themselves, as well as, their relationship.[8] The Sun magazine revealed on March 23rd that Jordan had filed a temporary restraining order against Jessi the same day he filed for divorce - March 20th. Jessi opposed the order on the same day. The cause of the TRO was not revealed, though it was rumored to be a move to stop Jessi from publicly speaking about the divorce during her upcoming podcast appearance on Alex Cooper's Call Her Daddy.[9] Page Six exclusively confirmed that the TRO was denied by the courts on March 24th.[10] Gallery[] Visit Jessi Draper's gallery!
